title: Compare categories with bars
summary: A bar chart compares categories. Bars usually start from zero so their lengths fairly represent the values.
introduction: A bar chart compares categories. Bars usually start from zero so their lengths fairly represent the values. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A bar chart compares categories. Bars usually start from zero so their lengths fairly represent the values.

blocks.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.bar(["Art", "Music", "Sport"], [3, 5, 4])
ax.set_ylabel("Votes")
plt.show()
blocks.title: Compare categories with bars

blocks.text: Music has the tallest bar because it has 5 votes.
